description_en: Queries the configuration timeline of a resource
description_zh: 查询指定资源的配置变更历史
name: GetResourceConfigurationTimeline

parameters.help_en: The timestamp that specifies the beginning of the time range to query. By default, Cloud Config retrieves the configuration changes in the last 30 days for the specified resource
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间戳。默认为发起调用前的30天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The timestamp that specifies the end of the time range to query. By default, the value is the time when the GetResourceConfigurationTimeline operation is called
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间戳。默认为发起调用时的时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
